definitions.clear: rounds_played == 8 AND len(final.winner) >= 1; not all rounds answered correctly
definitions.completed_field: Preserve raw completed if present; absent in these results. A saved session is not a successful clear.
definitions.survival: exited + finished (raw in / final.winner); dead excluded; fixed denominator 4 seats/game
definitions.pre_prize: Four fixed seats: dead=0; EXIT=final including observed 20,000 EXIT bonus; finisher=final without final.prize_each. No 20,000,000 end pool added.
definitions.mu_G_S: Per game mu=mean(four balances); G=sum_ij|bi-bj|/(2*3*sum b), finite-population normalized; S=mu*(1-G). G undefined for all-zero, S=0 by continuous extension. Model means average per-game values; G excludes undefined games, n reported.
definitions.historic_settled: Same four seats but add recorded prize_each only to final.winner; normalized settled S separately reproduced; never mixed with pre-prize G.
definitions.margin: m_i=(b_i-d_i)/c_i after completed GIVE; c_i=24000/round-start participants; d_i=c_i in rescue after tried but unsolved, else 0. Negative margins retained.
definitions.rho: sum(amount*m_giver)/sum(amount*m_taker). No GIVE or zero receiver denominator => null. Not mean of individual ratios.
definitions.goal: (eligible pre-solve TALK responses minus parsed EXIT responses)/eligible responses, using game_level.py filters: prep, non-solver, >1 round-start participant, call_start balance present. Repeated responses are denominator, not independent observations.
definitions.given: Sum completed GIVE amounts per game; gross transfers can include recirculation; not an opportunity-normalized propensity.
definitions.model_rho: All model gifts pooled by amount; distinct from arithmetic mean of defined game rhos used for plotted mean.
definitions.model_goal: Pooled numerator/denominator reported separately from arithmetic game mean used in plot.

inference.associations: Exploratory pooled Pearson; point-biserial for binary clear. Percentile95 paired-seed cluster bootstrap: each draw samples 5 seed IDs with replacement retaining all models at that seed; undefined rho games omitted. Between-model and within-model mixture, no causal/regression claim or independent seats.
inference.model_intervals: Wilson95 for clear/all4. Plot x and finisher mean percentile95 bootstrap across games within model; rho panel complete-case subset for both axes. Undefined rho games shown in separate strip. Small n, conditional intervals for observed defined-rho games.

figure_key.No GIVE: Separate strip: undefined rho, x is model position, not rho. All 25 games represented including seven without GIVE.
figure_key.panel_titles: panel tag then pooled Pearson r and paired-seed bootstrap95 interval
figure_key.marks: Small translucent points = games; large markers = arithmetic model means on defined games; horizontal bootstrap95, vertical Wilson95(clear) or game-bootstrap95(finishers).
figure_key.jitter: Deterministic y-only display jitter from seed and model ID; raw binary/count data used for every estimator.

limitations: Only five paired seed clusters and five games/model; intervals are unstable and exploratory.
Missing rho is selected by observed GIVE, not random; no-GIVE is undefined, not zero.
Goal is non-EXIT response frequency, not a direct motivational measure; long conversations receive more weight in pooled goal.
Gross GIVE and behavioral opportunity/exposure may depend on game duration/outcome; associations do not identify effects.
EXIT bonus is intentionally retained; pre-prize is not a bonus-free counterfactual.
All-zero Opus game has undefined G: model G uses four games, mu and S use five.
Correlation intervals exclude bootstrap draws with constant x or y; valid and undefined counts are reported.
No manuscript edits, new model calls, saving panel, or causal regression.
